name: section-template-context
body:
A section template is executed with the same reserved `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw` and `data` context as a slide layout, in addition to the section instance's own field values and rendered body. A section therefore can render the current slide's position label/total or any deck property — the motivating case is a footer section rendering `{{.slide.number}}/{{.slide.total}}` (e.g. `2a / 12`) on the slide it sits on — and can render its own place among its siblings via `{{.item.*}}` (item-context), including `{{.item.parent.<field>}}` to read the parent instance's fields. A section invoked by the `section` helper executes with the same context, its `.item` the one-item descriptor and its `.item.parent` the calling instance's fields (nil from a slide layout), and its `.raw` the values the call supplied (section-helper, raw-source-context). The context is present at every composition depth: a section template nested inside another section also receives it. Section instance fields stay directly addressable, unchanged; `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw` and `data` are the only additions.

AC: a footer section template containing `{{.slide.number}} / {{.slide.total}}` on the vertical slide `2a` of a twelve-slide deck renders `2a / 12`; the same section can render `{{.deck.title}}`; a section nested one level deeper still renders both, and its `{{.item.index}}`/`{{.item.number}}` reflect its position among its siblings; a section rendered by the `section` helper reads the same `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data` context.
